---
title: "TAOOH second-order Markov model, unadjusted — fitting"
subtitle: "Randomised group as the only patient-level covariate, observed weekly histories"
format: html
---

- Weekly states are not imputed, so one fit to the observed data.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(rms)
library(rmsb)
library(mostr)
library(posterior)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "markov.R"))
source(here("R", "plot-style.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "04-taooh", "05-unadjusted-second-order", "results")
model_dir <- here(results_dir, "models")
stan_dx_dir <- here(results_dir, "stan-dx")
dir.create(model_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(stan_dx_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

model_path <- here(model_dir, "model-01.rds")

# A small number of divergences is retained for review rather than causing an
# automatic full refit. Twenty or more divergences still trigger the retry.
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds <- config$diagnostics
taooh_diagnostic_thresholds$max_divergent_transitions <- 19L

treatment_prior <- list(
  c1 = list(tx = 1),
  c2 = list(tx = 0),
  contrast = expression(c1 - c2),
  mu = 0,
  sd = 0.541
)
```

```{r}
#| label: fit-model
#| include: false

if (!file.exists(model_path)) {
  # Coded as the completed datasets of the adjusted model.
  data <- read_parquet(here("analysis", "04-taooh", "results", "prepared.parquet")) |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    transmute(
      id = factor(id),
      week,
      y,
      yprev = factor(yprev, levels = 1:4),
      ypprev = factor(ypprev, levels = 1:4),
      tx = factor(tx)
    )

  # mostr's default first follow-up time (week 1) must be in the model data.
  stopifnot(min(data$week) == 1L)

  dd <- datadist(data)
  options(datadist = "dd")

  model_formula <- y ~ tx + rms::rcs(week, 4) + yprev + ypprev +
    week %ia% yprev + week %ia% ypprev + cluster(id)
  # The +100 offset keeps the seed apart from the adjusted fits.
  fit_seed <- config$seeds$taooh + 100L

  fit <- tryCatch(
    blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = treatment_prior,
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$warmup,
      refresh = 1,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    ),
    error = identity
  )

  diagnostics <- if (inherits(fit, "error")) {
    NULL
  } else {
    tryCatch(
      markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds),
      error = function(error) NULL
    )
  }

  if (is.null(diagnostics) || !isTRUE(diagnostics$passed)) {
    fit <- blrm_markov(
      formula = model_formula,
      pcontrast = treatment_prior,
      data = data,
      id_var = "id",
      time_var = "week",
      chains = config$markov$chains,
      iter = config$markov$retry_iterations,
      warmup = config$markov$retry_iterations / 2L,
      refresh = 0L,
      backend = "cmdstan",
      loo = FALSE,
      sampling.args = list(
        seed = fit_seed + 500000L,
        parallel_chains = config$markov$chains
      )
    )
    diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds)
  }

  if (!isTRUE(fit$pppo == 0L) || !is.null(fit$cppo)) {
    stop("The second-order TAOOH model must be a full proportional-odds model.")
  }
  assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

  saveRDS(fit, model_path, compress = "xz")
}
```

## Convergence

```{r}
#| label: diagnostics
#| echo: false

fit <- readRDS(model_path)
diagnostics <- markov_diagnostics(fit, taooh_diagnostic_thresholds)
assert_markov_diagnostics(diagnostics)

write_parquet(
  as.data.frame(diagnostics$summary) |>
    mutate(
      divergent_transitions = diagnostics$divergent_transitions,
      treedepth_exceeded = diagnostics$treedepth_exceeded,
      min_bfmi = diagnostics$min_bfmi
    ),
  here(results_dir, "diagnostics.parquet"),
  compression = "zstd"
)

writeLines(capture.output(stanDx(fit)), here(stan_dx_dir, "stan-dx-01.txt"))

# All coefficients and the random-intercept SD (sigmag).
trace_parameters <- c(colnames(fit$draws), colnames(fit$omega))
save_figure(
  plot_traces(trace_draws(fit, trace_parameters), ncol = 4),
  here(stan_dx_dir, "stan-dx-01.png"),
  height = 1.3 * ceiling(length(trace_parameters) / 4) + 1
)

tibble(
  iterations = fit$iter,
  refitted = fit$iter > config$markov$iterations,
  maximum_rhat = max(diagnostics$summary$rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
  minimum_ess_bulk = min(diagnostics$summary$ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
  minimum_ess_tail = min(diagnostics$summary$ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
  divergent_transitions = diagnostics$divergent_transitions,
  min_bfmi = diagnostics$min_bfmi
) |>
  kable(digits = 3)
```
